description.value:
You learn to contact spirits beyond the grave and let their power and knowledge flow through you. You gain the following benefits.

Guiding Whispers. You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidance00]{Guidance} cantrip, and it has a range of 60 feet when you cast it.

Spiritual Focus. You use tools that help you channel spirits. You gain a Gaming Set (playing cards) and proficiency with it, and you can use it, an Arcane Focus (crystal or orb), a Candle, or an Ink Pen as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.
